subject: Coordination gap: demo & pre-demo security checklist for ClearWave

Cc: eli.turner@clearwave.com
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request to lock in demo + security pre-check

Hi Rafael / Marissa —

Thanks again for the intro last week. We have a few engineers and procurement folks who want to see Redwood run on our datasets before we proceed with a PO. Can we schedule a 60-minute technical demo + a 15-minute pre-demo security Q&A?

Attendees (tentative): Samira Khan (SRE), Eli Turner (Procurement), 2x backend engineers.

Ideal windows this week: Wed 10th 10–12 PT or Thu 11th 14–17 PT. If you need more time, next Mon/Tue morning also works.

Also: procurement asked if we can get a short pre-demo checklist and an NDA draft — Eli is cc'd.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Sr. SRE, ClearWave Systems
[samira.khan@clearwave.com]

Hi Samira, Eli —

Great to meet you virtually. We can absolutely do both: a 60-minute technical walkthrough plus a 15-minute security/exports checkpoint. Marissa (SE) will lead the demo; Mina (security) can do the pre-demo Q&A.

Proposed slot: Thu Mar 11, 15:00–16:15 PT (60m demo + 15m Q&A). If that conflicts with procurement's calendar, I can open additional slots on Mon/Tue morning.

I've attached a short pre-demo checklist and an NDA draft (for procurement to review). If you want changes in the NDA, loop in your legal — Rafael here is not a lawyer. :)

Agenda (draft)
- 3:00–3:05 PM: Intros and scope
- 3:05–4:05 PM: Technical demo (Marissa) — ingestion, inferencing, perf baseline, VPC/private options
- 4:05–4:20 PM: Security Q&A + next steps (Mina)

Next steps: please confirm the slot or share alternatives and any specific test datasets / red flags you want covered.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0121

Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to lock in demo + security pre-check

Thanks Rafael. Samira — quick note from our side: to make the demo useful for your backend engineers, can you confirm whether you want us to walk through a streaming use case (low-latency) or a large-batch embedding job? That will change which models and infra we show.

If streaming: we'll demo Live inference with prefix caching and the latency/throughput dashboard. If batch: we'll show multi-GPU batching + cost projections.

Either works for us; a line from the engineers will let us prepare the right artifacts.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Option B: Mon Mar 14, 09:00–10:15 PT
